results.description: Keyword search for 'lungfish' returns the matching UNILAG thesis.
results.expected: The lungfish thesis is listed in the results.

results.description: Search by author surname 'Kemjika'.
results.expected: The 1989 Faculty of Education thesis by Kemjika is returned.

results.description: Filter results by the faculty facet 'Faculty of Pharmacy'.
results.expected: Only the Faculty of Pharmacy item is shown (1 result).

results.description: Filter by year range 2014 to 2014.
results.expected: Only items issued in 2014 are returned (3 results).

results.description: Search for 'model' where the title only contains the word 'Modelling'.
results.expected: Porter stemming returns the traffic congestion thesis.

results.description: Search for a nonsense term.
results.expected: The system reports no results without an error.

results.description: Search with SQL and FTS control characters.
results.expected: The query is handled safely and the page loads (HTTP 200).

results.description: Matched terms are highlighted in result snippets.
results.expected: The result contains a <mark> element around the search term.

results.description: Open an item page.
results.expected: Dublin Core fields (dc.title, dc.creator, dc.date.issued, dc.subject) are displayed.

results.description: An anonymous user requests an item still under review.
results.expected: The system returns 404 so unreviewed work is not exposed.

results.description: Export a citation in APA and BibTeX.
results.expected: APA text appears on the item page and a valid @phdthesis BibTeX entry is downloaded.

results.description: The item page lists related items using shared subjects and faculty.
results.expected: At least one related item is shown for a Faculty of Arts thesis.

results.description: Log in with valid librarian credentials.
results.expected: The user is redirected and the review queue is accessible.

results.description: Log in with a wrong password.
results.expected: Access is refused with an error message.

results.description: A depositor tries to open the librarian review queue.
results.expected: Access is denied (HTTP 403).

results.description: An anonymous user opens the submission form.
results.expected: The user is redirected to the login page.

results.description: Log in with an external 'next' address.
results.expected: The user is sent to the home page, not the external site.

results.description: A depositor submits a complete thesis record.
results.expected: The item is saved with status 'submitted' and a quality score.

results.description: Submit a record with the date '16/11/2026'.
results.expected: Submission is blocked and the ISO 8601 error is shown.

results.description: Upload a .docx file as the full text.
results.expected: The file is rejected with the message 'Only PDF files are accepted'.

results.description: Upload a PDF containing the word 'mangroveflux' and publish it.
results.expected: The item is found by full-text search for a word that appears only inside the PDF.

results.description: Check a UNILAG record whose abstract reads 'Full text attached'.
results.expected: The engine flags the abstract as a placeholder.

results.description: Normalise the author form 'Okafor, A.I' found in UNILAG records.
results.expected: The suggested form is 'Okafor, A. I.'.

results.description: Send draft metadata to the live check service.
results.expected: A score, a grade and a list of issues are returned.

results.description: Draft a record about 'Judicial Corruption' without subjects.
results.expected: The existing vocabulary term 'Judicial Corruption' is suggested.

results.description: Run the duplicate report over the loaded UNILAG records.
results.expected: The two 'Cement Dust' records deposited separately in the live repository are flagged.

results.description: Compare two different theses from the same faculty.
results.expected: They are not flagged as duplicates.

results.description: A depositor drafts a record with a near-identical title to an existing thesis.
results.expected: The live check returns the existing item as a possible duplicate.

results.description: A librarian approves a submitted item.
results.expected: The item becomes publicly visible and searchable.

results.description: A librarian returns an item without a note.
results.expected: The action is refused because a note to the depositor is required.

results.description: A returned item is corrected by the depositor and resubmitted.
results.expected: The status changes from 'returned' back to 'submitted'.

results.description: A depositor tries to edit an item that is already published.
results.expected: The edit is refused (HTTP 403).

results.description: Every workflow action is written to the audit log.
results.expected: The review page history lists 'submitted' and 'approve' actions.

results.description: A librarian applies automatic normalisation to a UNILAG record.
results.expected: Author forms are corrected and the quality score increases.

results.description: Download the file of an embargoed item.
results.expected: The download is refused (HTTP 403) while metadata stays visible.

results.description: Send the OAI-PMH Identify request.
results.expected: The response validates against the official OAI-PMH 2.0 XML schema.

results.description: Send ListRecords with metadataPrefix oai_dc.
results.expected: The response is schema-valid and contains only published records.

results.description: Validate the Dublin Core block of a GetRecord response.
results.expected: The oai_dc element validates against the oai_dc schema.

results.description: Send an illegal verb.
results.expected: The badVerb error code is returned in a schema-valid response.

results.description: Send GetRecord without the identifier argument.
results.expected: The badArgument error code is returned.

results.description: Request a record identifier that does not exist.
results.expected: The idDoesNotExist error code is returned.

results.description: Request an unsupported metadata format (marc21).
results.expected: The cannotDisseminateFormat error code is returned.

results.description: Harvest only the set fac_faculty_of_education.
results.expected: Every returned header carries that setSpec.

results.description: Harvest a list larger than one page (more than 50 records) using resumption tokens.
results.expected: Every record is retrieved once across pages and each page is schema-valid.

results.description: Harvest with from=2999-01-01 (a future date).
results.expected: The noRecordsMatch error code is returned.

results.description: View an item three times.
results.expected: The item view counter increases by three.

results.description: Run a search that has no matching items.
results.expected: The term appears under 'Searches with no results' on the analytics page.

results.description: A depositor opens the analytics dashboard.
results.expected: Access is denied (HTTP 403).
